description: SES publishes every email event in the aws.events registry with an untyped `detail` (`{"type": "object"}`). Type it from the SES developer guide: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/event-publishing-retrieving-sns-contents.html (fields) and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/event-publishing-retrieving-sns-examples.html (example records). The same record is what SES publishes to SNS and Firehose.
